status_or_notes: The server has data for 2000–2023 only (24 annual observations, facet 5746826742182915890). It has no values for 2024 or 2025. The same series also comes from the UNICEF provenance (undata/unicef/MNCH_MMR.SEX--F, data.unicef.org), where the values are identical to two decimals.
